subject.title: [Feature Request] ACP Session Skill Context Injection

question: Should ACP `sessions_spawn` support OpenClaw skill injection, and if so which selection, redaction, observability, and harness-parity contract should be the supported API?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but adding skill injection changes model-visible context, privacy boundaries, session state, and possibly config/default surfaces, so automation should not choose the permanent contract.

options.title: Explicit audited selector first
options.body: Add only an explicit per-call skill-id selector with bounded rendering, redaction, and audit metadata before considering auto/default selection.

options.title: Design broader auto/default selection
options.body: Keep the issue open for a larger product/security design that includes relevance detection, default skill sets, and resume semantics from day one.

options.title: Keep ACP skill injection unsupported
options.body: Close this direction and rely on harness-native skills plus the broader #95058 prompt-contract work instead of adding an OpenClaw ACP injection API.

recommendation.title: Explicit audited selector first
recommendation.body: Add only an explicit per-call skill-id selector with bounded rendering, redaction, and audit metadata before considering auto/default selection.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the related maintainer-labeled harness skill prompt contract issue that overlaps the product boundary this request needs.
